[center][size=4]Who doesn't love our 3 katana wielding, haramaki wearing, directionally challenged first mate of the Straw Hat pirates? What's even better than seeing him in One Piece? Dating and marrying him in Stardew Valley of course! Let's turn our favorite swordsman into a farmer boy and husband.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]So how did Zoro end up in Stardew Valley? Well, in an alternate timeline, instead of being sent to  Kuraigana Island by Bartholomew Kuma, he sent Zoro to Stardew Valley! And his captain said to meet again in two years time, so now Zoro is stuck here till then. Will you be able to change Zoro's heart and make him stay, or will he leave after the two years is up?[/size][/center]
[spoiler][center][size=4]He doesn't actually leave, Idk how to even implement that lol[/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[center][b][size=4]___________________________________________________________________[/size][/b] [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][font=Impact][color=#93c47d][b]🍎[/b][/color][color=#674ea7]C[/color][color=#3d85c6]o[/color][color=#45818e]n[/color][color=#93c47d]t[/color][color=#f1c232]e[/color][color=#e69138]n[/color][color=#cc0000]t[/color][color=#93c47d][b]🍏[/b][/color][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Zoro has around 1000+ lines of pre-marriage dialogue and around 500+ lines of marriage dialogue. Over 1500+ lines total![/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]I dislike how most villagers speak to you only once every day. So, I made it so that Zoro has dialogue in almost every major location he enters. He has plenty to say so make sure you talk to him every day and in different locations! He has dynamic randomized dialogue![/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[spoiler][center][size=4]Talk to him in the saloon after a hard days work (his dialogue changes based on season) [/size]
[size=4]Zoro moves around the fish shop and says different things at different times of day while working (his dialogue changes based on heart level)[/size]
[size=4]Talk to him whenever he's in the museum (his dialogue changes based on heart level). [/size]
[size=4]Talk to him when he's chilling by the dock on the beach (his dialogue changes based on heart level).[/size]
[size=4]Saturday dialogues are even coordinate specific! [/size]
[size=4]Not to mention his day-to-day dialogue based on heart level and seasons, too (ex: his 4 heart dialogue is different during spring compared to summer or fall or winter. [/size]
[size=4]No matter how fast or slow you level his heart up, he will say different things depending on different seasons. Never get tired of what he has to say![/size][/center]
[/spoiler]

[center][size=4]The official One Piece wiki says that Roronoa Zoro hates chocolate and dislikes icecream. So guess what I made him hate and dislike in Stardew Valley? Although there is no chocolate in vanilla Stardew Valley (heh, vanilla) so I made him hate Chocolate Cake and made him dislike Ice Cream [/size][size=4]and dislike other sweet things. It also says that his favorite foods are white rice, Sea King meat, and anything that goes with sake. So, I made him love and like [/size][size=4]majority of the seafood and fishes and alcohol.[/size][/center]

[color=#cc0000]Disclaimer[/color][/b][color=#cc0000]:[/color] 
[spoiler]Zoro is my first shot at modding, it was a struggle learning how to make a custom NPC. It took me a good six months from start to finish. I started this project in April thinking how long could it take, a month? And only uploaded him in October, so it's been a wild ride. So if there are any hiccups or bugs, please let me know. [b]I'm NOT an artist.[/b] This is my first attempt doing pixel art. I had to get someone to commission the portraits for Zoro. But I did most of his sprites, unfortunately. If you think my sprites look [b]absolute garbage[/b] and are willing to re-edit them for me, (If I like them) I will upload yours and give you credit.[/spoiler]

[color=#cc0000][b]Legal Disclaimer[/b]:[/color] 
[spoiler]I do not sell or make any profit off of this mod. I do not own, or am affiliated in any way to the official character Roronoa Zoro from One Piece.  Any likeness to the anime and manga character Roronoa Zoro is pure imitation and not the actual character or official art. All content of the NPC Roronoa Zoro is purely fan made.[/spoiler]

[b]DO NOT UPLOAD THIS MOD TO ANYWHERE ELSE.[/b] Please. Custom NPC- Roronoa Zoro will only be accessible through Nexus.

[b]_____________________________________________________[/b]
[color=#00ffff][b]Why Zoro?:[/b][/color] 
[spoiler]I've been bingeing One Piece again and Zoro is one of my favorite characters. I been wanting to create a custom NPC for Stardew Valley for a while now so I thought, why not? Let's put Zoro into the game.[size=1] Ya'll not gonna lie, the real truth is I made Zoro cuz I just wanted my female farmer to date & marry the hot samurai man. And suddenly it turned into a 6 month project. Sometimes I wonder if I made his dialogue too romantic during his 8 & 10 heart levels. And then I think naaahhh, it's my rendition of Zoro and I want Zoro to be lubby dubby when he is a boyfriend and husband. If you don't like, don't increase his heart level past 6![/size]

[b][color=#00ffff]Why download Custom NPC Zoro?:[/color] [/b]please.

[color=#00ffff][b]I would like to do a translation for Zoro:[/b][/color] If you are up to the task, please send me a message and we can collaborate.

[b][color=#00ffff]Spot grammar mistakes?:[/color] [/b]I hate those, too. So just let me know in comments or send me a message if you spot any in his dialogues.

[b][color=#00ffff]I found a bug, error, something went wrong, etc:[/color] [/b]Please let me know in the comments or send me a direct message. The only thing I haven't been able to test Zoro on yet is the movies & theater concession dialogues and reactions.
[b]
[color=#00ffff]Last comments:[/color][/b] Please let me know how Zoro is doing in your game. Do you like him? Dislike him? Thoughts? I'd love to hear back in the posts section of your experience with him.[/spoiler]
